text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it takes time and effort. First, you choose a destination and book your transport and accommodation. When you arrive, you discover new cultures, traditions and ways of life. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, and it helps you understand the place better. Sometimes you face language barriers, but you can use simple words, gestures or a translation app to communicate. These small challenges often make the journey more interesting. In the end, you return home with unforgettable memories and stories to share with friends and family.
